import json, numpy as np

with open('/root/autodl-tmp/recursive_gen_depth_est/artifacts/atlas_v2/atlas_v2_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

print('=== AUC-BASED MONOTONICITY (consecutive AUC decreasing) ===')
print('  Cell                  d0v1     d1v2     d2v3   Monotone?  Score')
print('  ' + '-'*70)

scores = {}
for cell_name, cell in data['cells'].items():
    aucs_rf = cell['auc']['random_forest']
    d0v1 = aucs_rf['depth0_vs_depth1']
    d1v2 = aucs_rf['depth1_vs_depth2']
    d2v3 = aucs_rf['depth2_vs_depth3']
    
    # Monotonicity: consecutive AUCs should decrease (harder to distinguish closer depths)
    monotone = d0v1 >= d1v2 >= d2v3
    # Score: fraction of correctly ordered pairs (3 comparisons: d0v1>d1v2, d1v2>d2v3, d0v1>d2v3)
    correct = int(d0v1>=d1v2) + int(d1v2>=d2v3) + int(d0v1>=d2v3)
    score = correct / 3.0
    scores[cell_name] = score
    
    print(f'  {cell_name:>20}  {d0v1:.4f}   {d1v2:.4f}   {d2v3:.4f}   {\"YES\" if monotone else \"NO\":>5}    {score:.4f}')

print(f'\n  Range: [{min(scores.values()):.4f}, {max(scores.values()):.4f}]')
print(f'  Mean: {np.mean(list(scores.values())):.4f}')
print(f'  All perfectly monotone: {all(v==1.0 for v in scores.values())}')

# Also compute feature-level monotonicity from atlas_summary
print('\n=== FEATURE MONOTONICITY (from atlas_summary, mean |score|) ===')
with open('/root/autodl-tmp/recursive_gen_depth_est/artifacts/atlas_v2/atlas_summary.json') as f:
    summary = json.load(f)

mono_data = summary.get('monotonicity', {})
for cell_name, feats in mono_data.items():
    mean_abs = np.mean([abs(v) for v in feats.values()])
    n_perfect = sum(1 for v in feats.values() if abs(v) == 1.0)
    print(f'  {cell_name:>20}: mean|score|={mean_abs:.4f}, n_perfectly_monotone={n_perfect}/19')
"
